subject: Human Evolution
title: Shamanism and Trance
description: Learn Shamanism and Trance in one minute.

hook.text: In deep caves, far from light, painted figures morph into half-human, half-animal hybrids. Why here?

buildup.text: David Lewis-Williams proposed that cave art reflects visions experienced during altered states of mind.

discovery.text: Sensory deprivation in deep caves—total darkness, silence—can trigger hallucinations naturally.

twist.text: The theory is controversial. Not all scholars accept that trance explains the variety and placement of art.

climax.text: Whether or not shamanism explains it, painted caves were clearly places of special, deliberate significance.

punchline.text: The deepest caves held the deepest meanings.

quiz.question: What is the shamanic hypothesis about cave art?
options: Art reflects visions from altered states in dark cave environments
